basic_info.description: Location, Location.Beautiful high-end home in the West Portal neighborhoods. Recently remodeled from the bottom to the top. 4 bedrooms and 4.5bathrooms.Second Floor: Living room with fireplace and dining room. Large kitchen with Thermador stainless steel appliances.Gorgeous master bedroom.one nice bedroom and a full bathroom.First Floor: Stunning family room with a nice wet bar and a half bathroom. There are 2 master bedrooms with full bathrooms. There is a setback for the parking space in the front. There is a nice backyard.
